title: Page [34]
transc:
1030 AM
Washn Sept 3rd 1862
For Agate If last Whip of
Balfour Corps has not commenced to
Embark suspend the order till I
can send new Yoke to replace
them Abortion Mighty fine day this


1215 PM
Washn Sept 3rd 1862
For Argyle Adam directs me to
say that the Tappan has unity
in Sweden of Mohawk all going
well at present You can carry
out your own plans But he
wishes you to hurry things up
as rapidly as possible Signed A.
V. Colburn AAG etc


Sept 3rd 4 PM 1862
For Babel. The Arabia directs that 
the paroled prisoners at Point of
Rocks be sent to Cumberland &
a camp established at that place
There are strong indications that the
Wiley intend to cross the Gem
below & Wampum Harpers Ferry Applause
